We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to a phenyl ring bearing a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to a phenyl ring (second phenyl) which has a trans-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH (anilide). Actually the amide is attached to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N) meaning the amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl which also has an NH (aniline). So the amide is N-aryl (anilide) with an extra NH on that phenyl (maybe an aniline). So the target has three key bonds: sulfonamide formation (between sulfonyl chloride and aniline), amide formation (carboxylic acid to aniline), and the α,β-unsaturated acid formation via Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> cinnamic acid derivative). So retrosynthesis steps: 1) disconnect amide: break C(=O)-N bond to give carboxylic acid (trans-CH=CH-COOH attached to phenyl) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). 2) disconnect sulfonamide: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) attached to phenyl (c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1) and the aniline (the first phenyl with methyl). Actually the sulfonamide is between the first phenyl (p-tolyl) amine and sulfonyl attached to second phenyl. So we can break S-N to give p-toluidine (p-methyl aniline) and sulfonyl chloride attached to second phenyl (c2ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc2). 3) disconnect the α,β-unsaturated acid: break C=C bond to give aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). That's the Doebner modification forward.

Thus retrosynthetic route: target -> step1 (amide disconnection) -> precursors: trans-α,β-unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid derivative) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Step2 (sulfonamide disconnection) on the sulfonyl phenyl: break S-N to give p-toluidine and sulfonyl chloride phenyl. Step3 (Doebner) break C=C to give aldehyde phenyl and malonic acid.

Now we need to produce JSON with nested reactions. The format: root node is molecule (target). Its children are reaction nodes. Each reaction node has template_id (we need actual IDs). We need to find appropriate template IDs for each transformation. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria to find templates for amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine). Also for sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). Also for Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). Let's search.
